review.base: No base district is named. The ordinance lists its own allowed uses and prohibits all others.

notes: Development must follow the site plan (Exhibit A) and the site, landscape, floor, facade and valet plans (Exhibit B) of the 2023 ordinance.

A valet parking plan must be submitted to Town staff. If valet is offered, it must use park-and-stroll or similar drop-off at any valet stand, and customers must be able to request a car before arriving.
A 5 ft sidewalk is required along the full Belt Line Road frontage.
